title: One Shot small cozy Arcade Mobile Game
author: DIY_Ali

comments.author: CreativeProblem7803
comments.body:
Hey, the game looks cute, but this ultra precision clicking is too hard for 99% of all players (maybe you have added rubber-band effects that make the placing very forgiving), I have build a similar game called Spin&Mow on CrazyGames and it flopped hard.   
Some players enjoy overcoming struggles and to make it till the end, but most hate it. My games movement is pretty much like your game. If you had the hopes of putting it on a platform or on mobile, you will not have the luck of having long play session on the average playtime over all players, Im quite sure of it.   
It is not to demotivate you, but to learn from my struggles. Spin&Mow earned 2€ over 5 months on CrazyGames, one of the best paying web game platform for web games.

But feel free to proof me wrong if you still continue and publish and have success with it.

replies.author: Kalaminator
replies.body:
I don't agree, this is a game more about timing than "ultra" precision. Still most of games of this style normally are rhythm based to help you with the timing and I see  this one has no music. You have a dance on ice on Steam which is simple game which uses this type of concept but it's well thought despite it's simplicity and has overwhelmingly positive reviews on Steam.

This said, I'm against one shot games, I think this is people trying to get easy money with low effort and end up with crappy games that have no human thought put to it flooding the stores with rubbish. I mean garbage games like these existed before AI, but people did not come to reddit to promote garbage at least, unlike nowadays with people like OP. I'm all in on people using AI to create games, as a tool, not as a replacement.
